thread:
mira: Quick sync — dry run for joint announcement with Snowflake + Databricks + VectorDB connector planned for next Wed. Can everyone confirm owners & blockers?

alex: I can take the runtime testing scope. Will validate cold-starts + KV-cache behavior on Snowflake ingest.

sam: I'll own the press/marketing timeline. Need copy by Tue EOD. Any embargo constraints?

jordan: Solutions will run 3 customer POCs next week, need marketplace listing link and install steps.

lily: Partner ops: legal has one small clause re. co-marketing assets. I quoted partner legal, waiting.

mira: Outstanding items checklist:
```
- final compatibility matrix (alex)
- install guide + quickstart (jordan)
- marketplace listing draft (sam)
- co-mkt assets + logos (lily)
- perf benchmarks on standard 2xA100 (eng-infra)
```

alex: Perf bench — can we borrow Databricks infra for the heavy rip? If not, I'll run on our Dedicated pool and tag results.

partners-bot: Reminder: marketplace submission deadline 1717090000 (Thu 09:00 UTC). Link: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/submissions

sam: re embargo — Snowflake legal wants 48h notice. Databricks wants to coordinate demo video release. So target internal freeze Mon EOD.

jordan: For install steps, do we want both "self-hosted connector" and "managed ingest" flows? Recommend both.

lily: Logos: Snowflake provided new guidelines. Databricks sent a PNG pack. I placed both in /drive/partners/sd-vector/assets

alex: Quick question on supported variants: Are we listing quantized model variants as "supported"? Prod notes may need clarifying.

mira: Good call. Let's list "recommended: fp16, int8-ggml (experimental)". Alex please add exact tag strings.

sam: I'll draft announcement copy and share for review by Mon 10:00. @mira @alex feel free to edit.

jordan: I'll prep a runbook for the first 48h after go-live — rollback, metrics, contact rota.

lily: Legal flagged co-marketing logos should include trademark footnote. I'll add to assets.

mira: OK team — next sync Tue 9:30 PT. If any blockers before then, drop them here. :+1:

alex: ack. starting perf runs today."
